resources.string: Most people use rentular.com. If your organisation runs its own Rentular server, you can connect to that one instead.
The server has to use https. Plain http is not supported.
That does not look like a server address. Try something like rent.example.be.
This does not look like a Rentular server, or it runs an older version.
Could not reach this server. Check the address and your connection.
This version of the app is no longer supported. Install the update from the Play Store to keep using Rentular.
%3$s runs Rentular %1$s, but this app needs version %2$s. Ask the person who manages the server to update it.
%2$s runs an older version of Rentular. This app needs version %1$s. Ask the person who manages the server to update it.
Rentular could not check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again.
%1$s did not respond. Check your connection, or contact the person who manages the server.
